params.body:
An insight carried on by another (a merge, a refinement, a folded twin) keeps its row and its address, so a reading can be traced to what replaced it. It should no longer be a result, a count or an input. Several readers still treated it as one.

## What read superseded insights

- `insights-index` and `insights-search`: the Observatory's Insights page got every superseded row and hid them in the browser, except in the status counts, the total and the timeline.
- `overview-lite` headlines and the `dailyInsight` count.
- `getRecentInsights`: the "existing insights" that suggest and deepen give the model. The newest row is often the reading that was just merged away.
- The chat context: insight count, draft count and the fifteen recent insights.
- `signalMix` and the source scorecard counted a signal as cited when only a superseded insight named it. The scorecard feeds the source trial gate.
- The concept lifecycle kept a concept alive on a superseded insight's reference.
- `bin/insight-sectors.mjs` wrote sectors onto superseded insights.

## The rule

`live-insight.mjs` gets `CURRENT_INSIGHT` / `currentInsightSql` / `isCurrentInsight`: `superseded_by IS NULL` and status not `superseded`. This is wider than live (a lapsed insight is current, since nothing replaced it). `wantsHistory(params)` accepts `history: true` (or `'true'`, `'1'`, `1`) and nothing else.

## History mode

`insights-index`, `insights-search` and `overview-lite` take `params.history = true` and then return the superseded rows as well, marked `supersededBy`. `insights-rows` and `insight-detail` answer by id either way, so an old link still opens. The agent `query` tool says so in its description.

Left as they are, on purpose: production counts (insights born per hour/day in monitor, heavy, evals), the live feed's "merged" events, refinement evals, the showcase's chain-following to the head, and `concept-fold`, which rewrites references on every row.

## Tests

`test/current-insights.test.mjs`: the rule in SQL and in memory, the history switch, default exclusion (index, search, home, overview, count), history inclusion (index, search, overview, lookup by id), and three regressions: suggest/deepen reading the newest superseded insight, a refinement left in `draft` reaching the review queue, and a signal counted as cited through a superseded insight. Without the change 7 of them fail.

Full suite on the workbench: 1280 of 1286. The 6 failures are `report-render`, which needs `pdftoppm` (installed in CI, not on the workbench), the same as on main. Typecheck clean.

## Order

Merge this before the dashboard PR: once the toggle is gone, the page relies on the index leaving superseded rows out.
params.title: Current insights by default, superseded ones only in history mode
